lines.en: label otohaspecial15p1:
scene otohasnewhair1
I make my way into the dorm and, before I even have the chance to knock on anyone’s door, I find Rin hesitantly standing outside of room eight.
lines.zh: 我走进宿舍，还没来得及敲任何人的门，就发现 Rin 正犹豫地站在八号房门外。

lines.en: And I now understand why.
lines.zh: 而我现在明白为什么了。

lines.en: : Is Nodoka broken again?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 又坏掉了吗？

lines.en: : It’s been going on for like five minutes. I just want to kiss my girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 都闹了差不多五分钟了。我只想亲我女朋友一下。

lines.en: : Let's hope it ends soon because I want to watch you kiss your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 但愿快点结束，因为我想看你亲你女朋友。

lines.en: : You might have to hide outside the door and just peek in. I’ll leave it cracked for you. Otoha doesn’t like being watched, I don’t think. Or, I don’t know. Maybe she does. But I’m too scared to ask right now.
lines.zh: : 你可能得躲在门外偷看。我给你留条门缝。我觉得 Otoha 不太喜欢被人看着。也可能，我也不知道。也许她喜欢。不过我现在不敢问。

lines.en: : I’ll go fill up a bucket of water that we can dump on her or something.
lines.zh: : 我去装一桶水什么的，到时候泼她身上。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair2
: Are you trying to tell me I can’t get my girlfriend wet?
lines.zh: : 你是在暗示我没法让我女朋友湿吗？

lines.en: : I was talking about Nodoka. But I can grab a second bucket for Otoha if you aren’t feeling very confident in yourself.
lines.zh: : 我说的是 Nodoka。不过如果你对自己没那么自信，我可以再拿一桶给 Otoha 用。

lines.en: : Better to err on the side of caution. Grab three buckets just in case something goes wrong with me as well.
lines.zh: : 还是谨慎点好。拿三桶吧，万一我自己也出点状况呢。

lines.en: : On it.
lines.zh: : 这就去。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair3
: What’s this about buckets?
lines.zh: : 这是在说什么桶？

lines.en: : Woah. You look pretty good for someone who was having a manic breakdown like, five seconds ago.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。一个五秒钟前还在躁狂发作的人，看起来气色倒挺好。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair4
: Breakdown?
lines.zh: : 发作？

lines.en: : I’m afraid I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Sensei...she’s got telekinesis now...don’t make any sudden movements.
lines.zh: : Sensei……她现在会隔空移物了……别做任何突然的动作。

lines.en: : Is that...Otoha throwing shit around in there?
lines.zh: : 那是……Otoha 在里面砸东西吗？

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair3
: There comes a time in the spring of youth when we must {i}all{/i} throw something against the wall. Natsume Soseki said that.
lines.zh: : 在青春之春里，总有那么一个时刻，我们{i}所有人{/i}都得往墙上摔点什么。这是夏目漱石说的。

lines.en: : No he didn’t.
lines.zh: : 他没说过。

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe he didn’t. But I did just now and, let's face it- he wasn't {i}that{/i} much better than me.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许他没有。但我刚刚说了，而且说实话——他也没比我强{i}多少{/i}。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair5
: That’s...Otoha doing that? Why? She seemed fine when we were texting a few hours ago.
lines.zh: : 那是……Otoha 在砸？为什么？几小时前我们发消息的时候她还好好的。

lines.en: : Oh. That was me. Surprise.
lines.zh: : 哦。那是我。惊喜吧。

lines.en: : But I...told you I love you.
lines.zh: : 可我……跟你说了我爱你啊。

lines.en: : And I love you too, Rin. If it were not for your relationship with my roommate, I’d have my tongue so far up your-
lines.zh: : 我也爱你，Rin。要不是你跟我室友的那种关系，我的舌头早就伸进你的——

lines.en: : Please don’t finish that sentence.
lines.zh: : 求你别把这句话说完。

lines.en: : Please finish that sentence.
lines.zh: : 请务必把这句话说完。

lines.en: : ...vagina that I would be able to lick your tonsils.
lines.zh: : ……阴道里，深到能舔到你的扁桃体。

lines.en: : Are you...an eldritch horror now?
lines.zh: : 你现在……是某种不可名状的恐怖生物吗？

lines.en: : You can call me Azathoth. Azzie for short. Now, I believe we were about to make out?
lines.zh: : 你可以叫我阿撒托斯。简称阿撒。那么，我想我们刚才正要接吻来着？

lines.en: : No...I {i}believe{/i} you were about to tell me what’s going on with my girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 不……我{i}认为{/i}你正要告诉我，我女朋友到底怎么了。

lines.en: : There’s nothing going on with your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你女朋友什么事都没有。

lines.en: : Okay. There may be something going on with your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 好吧。你女朋友也许确实有点状况。

lines.en: : But it’s no more than a standard case of the plight of the artist.
lines.zh: : 但那不过是艺术家的困境，标准案例而已。

lines.en: : In times like these, it is best to leave people like Otoha alone until they finish what they started.
lines.zh: : 这种时候，最好别去打扰 Otoha 这样的人，等她们把手头的事做完再说。

lines.en: : Now, despite how much experience I’ve gained throughout the undisclosed amount of time I’ve been here, I am no expert when it comes to the woes of an ailing female.
lines.zh: : 虽说我在这里待了多久不便透露，也积累了那么多经验，但对于一个痛苦中的女性的烦恼，我可算不上专家。

lines.en: : However...I have a hard time believing it’s best to leave Otoha to her own devices if she is currently breaking glass all over your bedroom.
lines.zh: : 不过……如果她此刻正在你们卧室里到处砸玻璃，我很难相信「随她去」是最好的办法。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair6
: I break glass all over my bedroom all the time and you never come to {i}my{/i} rescue. And to think that I’ve been looking up to you as a father figure this whole time.
lines.zh: : 我天天在我卧室里到处砸玻璃，你也从来没来救过{i}我{/i}。亏我还一直把你当父亲一样仰慕。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} come to your rescue. You’re just beyond saving.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}来救过你。只是你已经没救了。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair7
: Aww...Daddy...
lines.zh: : 哎呀……爸爸……

lines.en: : I won’t stay long...I just want to check up on her and make sure she’s doing okay.
lines.zh: : 我不会待太久……我只是想看看她，确认她没事。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair8
: Okay. But it won’t be pretty and you can’t say I didn’t try to warn you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。不过场面不会好看，别说我没警告过你。

lines.en: : Now, if you two will please excuse me, I have several prior engagements to tend to.
lines.zh: : 那么，请两位失陪一下，我还有几个先约好的事要处理。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair9
: Oh, and under no circumstance should you attempt to touch her. I made that same mistake once just to see what would happen and it did {i}not{/i} go very well.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，无论如何都别试着碰她。我犯过一次同样的错，就想看看会怎样，结果{i}一点{/i}都不妙。

lines.en: : Have fun!
lines.zh: : 玩得开心！

lines.en: : So, it looks like it wasn’t Nodoka after all.
lines.zh: : 看来果然不是 Nodoka。

lines.en: : I didn’t even realize Otoha had a side like this...
lines.zh: : 我都不知道 Otoha 还有这样一面……

lines.en: : Is it really okay to go in there? Shouldn't we just...leave?
lines.zh: : 真的可以进去吗？我们是不是该……就这么走掉？

lines.en: : Well...was it good for you those times I walked in on you at {i}your{/i} darkest?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我撞见{i}你{/i}最黑暗的那些时刻时，对你来说是好事吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe? But if I didn’t know about this side of her, it means she’s probably been keeping it a secret on purpose, right?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许是吧？可如果我从来不知道她有这一面，那说明她大概是故意藏着，对吧？

lines.en: : What if she doesn’t want me to see her like that?
lines.zh: : 万一她不想让我看到她那个样子呢？

lines.en: : Only one way to find out.
lines.zh: : 只有一个办法能知道。

lines.en: scene black
: Yeah...I’m just here to check on her. And if she wants us to leave, we’ll leave.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我只是来看看她。如果她想让我们走，我们就走。

lines.en: : It’s that simple...
lines.zh: : 就这么简单……

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair10
{s}Except it isn’t.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}可惜并不是。{/s}

lines.en: : Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes
lines.zh: : 没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤

lines.en: Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad. Nothing rhymes with sad."
lines.zh: 押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。没有什么能和悲伤押韵。”

lines.en: : Uhh...Otoha?
lines.zh: : 呃……Otoha？

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair11
: Otoha isn’t here. Go away.
lines.zh: : Otoha 不在。走开。

lines.en: : I just...wanted to see if you were doing okay. It was pretty loud out in the hall-
lines.zh: : 我只是……想看看你还好吗。外面走廊上动静挺大的——

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair12
: {b}WHAT FUCKING PART OF “GO AWAY” DO YOU NOT UNDERSTAND?! I’M WORKING!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}“滚开”这两个字你他妈到底有哪部分听不懂？！我在工作！{/b}

lines.en: : Y-Yeah! Okay...Okay. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 是、是！好……好吧。没关系。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair13
: Oh. Crescendo. I don’t need words to get it across if everything the words are built {i}around{/i} starts spinning. Spinning and climbing.
lines.zh: : 哦。渐强。如果那些词所{i}围绕{/i}的一切都开始旋转，我就不需要词也能表达出来。旋转，攀升。

lines.en: : I will reach the top one way or another. It doesn’t matter how it happens, it just matters that I get there. If I get there, things will be good again. I have to make them good. I have to be good.
lines.zh: : 无论如何我都会爬到顶。怎么到的不重要，重要的是我到了那里。只要我到了那里，一切就会重新好起来。我必须让一切好起来。我必须变好。

lines.en: : I’m amazing. A prodigy. Everything I touch turns to gold.
lines.zh: : 我很了不起。我是天才。我碰到的东西都会变成金子。

lines.en: : King Midas! Metaphor! Speak through symbols when nothing else can show how you feel! I will be heard. You will hear me.
lines.zh: : King Midas！隐喻！当别的一切都无法表达你的感受时，就用象征来说话！我要被听见。你会听见我的。

lines.en: : Are you ready to leave yet?
lines.zh: : 你准备走了吗？

lines.en: : I don’t really know...my mind is telling me no, but-
lines.zh: : 我也不知道……我的理智在说不行，不过——

lines.en: : But your body is telling you yes?
lines.zh: : 但你的身体在说可以？

lines.en: : This really isn’t the time for early 90’s pop culture references, Sensei. And you know things are bad when even I’m saying that.
lines.zh: : 现在真不是玩九十年代初流行梗的时候，Sensei。连我都这么说，你就知道情况有多糟了。

lines.en: : I couldn’t help myself and I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 我没忍住，抱歉。

lines.en: : What I was saying is that my mind is telling me no, but my heart is telling me that Otoha might need me right now.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我的理智在说不行，但我的心在说，Otoha 现在可能需要我。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair15
: {b}OTOHA, THIS! OTOHA, THAT! CAN’T YOU SEE I DON’T NEED ANYONE?! I CAN FUNCTION ON MY OWN! NOW LET ME WRITE IN FUCKING PEACE!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}OTOHA 这样！OTOHA 那样！你看不出我谁都不需要吗？！我自己能行！现在让我他妈的安静写歌！{/b}

lines.en: : I’m starting to think Nodoka was right. Which is annoying because she’s kind of always right and there’s no way things can stay that way forever.
lines.zh: : 我开始觉得 Nodoka 是对的。这挺烦人的，因为她几乎总是对的，而这种事不可能永远这样下去。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair16
: That way forever...something-something...clever?...In the...something...December...something remember! That’s it! The bridge is finished! I’ll fill in the blanks later! I’m a genius.
lines.zh: : 永远那样……什么什么……巧妙？……在那个……什么……十二月……什么还记得！对了！桥段写完了！空着的地方我回头再填！我是天才。

lines.en: : Maybe the bucket would have been a good idea after all?
lines.zh: : 也许那一桶水本来真该准备的？

lines.en: : Otoha...can you at least look at me? Your hair’s a mess. Do you need anything to eat? A...shower maybe?
lines.zh: : Otoha……你至少能看我一眼吗？你头发乱糟糟的。要不要吃点什么？或者……洗个澡？

lines.en: : There needs to be something else...something different...a cello? Theremin? Something that will pop! To draw attention away from the parts that aren’t meant to stick the way the chorus is.
lines.zh: : 还得有点别的东西……不一样的东西……大提琴？特雷门琴？某种能炸出来的东西！好把注意力从那些不该像副歌那样抓住人的部分上引开。

lines.en: : But it can’t be too distracting. If it’s too distracting, {i}nothing{/i} will stick. And if nothing sticks, everything falls. Everything falls but me. I stay on top. Where I belong.
lines.zh: : 但也不能太抢眼。太抢眼的话，就{i}什么{/i}都抓不住人了。如果什么都抓不住，一切就都塌了。一切都会塌，只有我不会。我留在顶上。我该在的地方。

lines.en: : {i}Somewhere I belooooong.{/i} Fucking Linkin Park, man. So good. I bet they wouldn’t struggle with fucking {i}bullshit{/i} like this. I’m a fake. I’m pathetic. Fuck you, Otoha. Fuck you. Piece of shit. You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : {i}我归属的某处——{/i}他妈的林肯公园，老兄。太好听了。我打赌他们才不会为这种{i}狗屁{/i}挣扎。我是个冒牌货。我真可悲。去你的，Otoha。去你的。废物。你真恶心。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair17
: Hey...I’ll run to the convenience store and grab you dinner or something. After that, I’ll be out of your hair. Okay? Is there anything you want?
lines.zh: : 嘿……我跑去便利店给你买点晚饭什么的。之后我就不烦你了。好吗？你想要点什么？

lines.en: : Dadadadaaa......dada.......daaaaa.....fuck. No. Again. From the top. Dadadaaaa-
lines.zh: : 哒哒哒哒啊………哒哒………哒啊啊啊……操。不对。再来。从头开始。哒哒哒啊——

lines.en: : Rin, I don’t know if that’s a good-
lines.zh: : Rin，我不知道这样好不好——

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair18
: Otoha, look at me. You don’t have to be perfect all the time if it’s weighing on you. You could always-
lines.zh: : Otoha，看着我。如果这让你有压力，你不必时时刻刻都完美。你可以——

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair19
: Ngh-!?
: {b}I TOLD YOU TO GET THE FUCK AWAY FROM ME, YOU ANNOYING PIECE OF SHIT! I’M TRYING TO WORK!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我说了给我他妈的滚远点，你这个烦人的废物！我在试着工作！{/b}

lines.en: : Woah. You can’t just-
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你不能就这么——

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair20
: Ah! Oh my god! Rin! I didn’t mean that! Are you okay?!
lines.zh: : 啊！我的天！Rin！我不是故意的！你没事吧？！

lines.en: : You just...
lines.zh: : 你刚才……

lines.en: : You just {i}hit{/i} me...
lines.zh: : 你刚才{i}打{/i}了我……

lines.en: : It was an accident! You surprised me! I’m so so sorry! Really! I get...jumpy when people sneak up on me like that!
lines.zh: : 那是意外！你吓到我了！我真的非常非常抱歉！真的！有人这样突然靠近的时候，我会……一惊一乍的！

lines.en: : Yeah...Yeah, I understand...
lines.zh: : 是……是，我明白……

lines.en: : I was warned to not touch you anyway and...
lines.zh: : 反正也有人警告过我别碰你，而且……

lines.en: : I kind of just forgot...in the heat of the moment...
lines.zh: : 我就是……一时情急给忘了……

lines.en: scene black
I take a step back and let the two of them figure this out.
lines.zh: 我退后一步，让她们俩自己解决这个问题。

lines.en: I have no place here anyway.
lines.zh: 反正这里也没我的位置。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair21
: Does it hurt? Are you okay? We should put something cold on your cheek so it doesn’t swell up. Holy shit, I can’t believe I just did that. Oh my god. Oh my fucking god.
lines.zh: : 疼吗？你没事吧？我们该拿点冰的东西敷在你脸上，免得肿起来。我靠，我真不敢相信自己刚做了什么。我的天。我他妈的天。

lines.en: : I’m fine...it wasn’t that hard. You just surprised me, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我没事……打得没那么重。你只是吓到我了，就这样。

lines.en: : Rin, I’m so sorry. Hit me back to make up for it. As many times you want. I deserve it.
lines.zh: : Rin，我太抱歉了。你打回来吧，就当扯平。想打几下打几下。我活该。

lines.en: : I’m not going to hit you, Otoha...
lines.zh: : 我不会打你的，Otoha……

lines.en: : You should! I just hit you! You’re my precious girlfriend who I’d do anything for and I {i}hit{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 你该打！我刚打了你！你是我愿意为她做任何事的宝贝女朋友，而我居然{i}打{/i}了你！

lines.en: : Well, now you’re just making me blush.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你这话说得我都脸红了。

lines.en: : I’m so sorry. What can I do to make it up to you? Name it. I’ll do anything you want. Anything at all.
lines.zh: : 我太抱歉了。我要怎么弥补你？你说。你想让我做什么都行。什么都行。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair22
: Did you dye your hair back?
lines.zh: : 你把头发染回去了？

lines.en: : Huh?
: Your highlights are gone. When did that happen?
lines.zh: : 你的挑染没了。什么时候的事？

lines.en: : I don’t...I don’t really remember...but why is {i}that{/i} what-
lines.zh: : 我不……我不太记得了……可为什么你偏偏在意{i}这个{/i}——

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair23
: You look...kinda {i}hot{/i} like this.
lines.zh: : 你这样看起来……有点{i}辣{/i}。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair24
: Oh! Sorry. Just...one surprise after the other today.
lines.zh: : 哦！抱歉。只是……今天一个接一个的意外。

lines.en: : Otoha, if you want to make it up to me, just take care of yourself.
lines.zh: : Otoha，如果你想弥补我，就好好照顾自己。

lines.en: : I’m no stranger to locking myself away until {i}I{/i} find what it takes to move forward again. So I get it. And I’m not trying to change you or anything.
lines.zh: : 我很清楚把自己关起来、直到{i}自己{/i}找到重新往前走的东西是什么感觉。所以我懂。而且我也不是想改变你什么的。

lines.en: : This is...a new side of you, yeah. And I’m not sure why you hid it from me, but...that doesn’t matter right now.
lines.zh: : 这确实是……你新的一面。我不知道你为什么瞒着我，不过……现在这不重要。

lines.en: : What matters is that you eat...and maybe get some sleep...and {i}then{/i} finish your work. I’m sure the song you’re writing isn’t going to just run away on you.
lines.zh: : 重要的是你吃点东西……也许再睡一会儿……{i}然后{/i}再完成你的工作。我相信你在写的那首歌不会自己跑掉的。

lines.en: : Okay?
lines.zh: : 好吗？

lines.en: : Why are you being so nice to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么对我这么好？

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair25
: Because I fuck up all the time...You’re allowed to make a few mistakes as well.
lines.zh: : 因为我自己也老是搞砸……你偶尔犯几个错也是可以的。

lines.en: : Just don’t go cheating on me or anything.
lines.zh: : 只要别去出轨什么的就行。

lines.en: : You really don’t want to hit me back?
lines.zh: : 你真的不想打回来？

lines.en: : And risk damaging that beautiful face? I’ll pass.
lines.zh: : 冒着毁掉那张漂亮脸蛋的风险？那还是算了。

lines.en: : Plus, now that it’s behind us, I actually think getting slapped was kind of kinky. I think I might be into it.
lines.zh: : 再说，既然已经过去了，我其实觉得被扇一巴掌还挺刺激的。我觉得我可能有点上瘾了。

lines.en: : Rin, I’m so sorry. I really am. It’ll never happen again.
lines.zh: : Rin，我真的很抱歉。真的。这种事再也不会发生了。

lines.en: : I told you. It's fine.
lines.zh: : 我说过了。没事。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair26
: Also, Sensei is here. Say hi.
lines.zh: : 还有，Sensei 也在这儿。打个招呼吧。

lines.en: : Hey, Otoha. You look fucking miserable.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Otoha。你看上去惨透了。

lines.en: : I’ve...had better days...
lines.zh: : 我……有过更好的日子……

lines.en: scene black
scene otohasnewhair27
: So, uhh...you saw all that?
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……你全都看见了？

lines.en: : I did.
lines.zh: : 看见了。

lines.en: : And...what did you think?
lines.zh: : 那……你怎么想？

lines.en: : I think that your girlfriend is a little too forgiving and that you have a lot of work to do if you’re going to make up for slapping her across the face when all she was doing was making sure you were okay.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你女朋友有点太宽容了，而且你要弥补的事还多着呢——她只是想确认你没事，你就扇了她一巴掌。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair28
: You and I might not agree on much, but...I can’t argue with any of that.
lines.zh: : 你和我可能在很多事上都谈不拢，不过……这番话我一句都反驳不了。

lines.en: : On a somewhat brighter note, I now believe that you may be able to dethrone your floormates across the hall in the race for “messiest dorm room” seeing as both you {i}and{/i} Nodoka are like this.
lines.zh: : 稍微光明一点地说，我现在相信，你或许能从走廊对面的室友手里夺下“最乱宿舍”的宝座——毕竟你{i}和{/i} Nodoka 都是这副样子。

lines.en: : In my defense, even though I probably shouldn’t be trying to defend anything right now...she is much worse than I am.
lines.zh: : 替我自己说句公道话，虽然现在大概不是我该辩解的时候……她比我严重多了。

lines.en: : I don’t know. She’s never hit an actual person before.
lines.zh: : 那可不一定。她可从没真的打过人。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair29
: I meant, like...in terms of...actual destruction...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，就……实际的破坏而言……

lines.en: : Can we maybe just forget about the slap for now and try to make things normal again? I’m really not that bothered by it.
lines.zh: : 我们能不暂时忘掉那一巴掌，试着让一切恢复正常吗？我真的没那么在意。

lines.en: : There’s no way I can just forget that...
lines.zh: : 我不可能就这么忘了的……

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair30
: I’m so embarrassed...and disappointed in myself...and so, so fucking stupid. I seriously can’t believe that just happened.
lines.zh: : 我太丢人了……也对自己太失望了……而且真的、真的蠢透了。我真的不敢相信刚才发生了那种事。

lines.en: : And on top of that, I look like a serial killer and haven’t changed my clothes since Friday. So yeah, life’s not really coming up Otoha right now.
lines.zh: : 而且除此之外，我看起来像个连环杀手，从上周五起就没换过衣服。所以是啊，现在的日子对 Otoha 来说真不怎么样。

lines.en: : When did this start?...And, better question, what {i}is{/i} this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么时候开始的？……还有个更好的问题，这到底{i}是{/i}什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know...fucking...this just happens when I get too many...feelings, sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……操……有时候我积攒了太多……情绪，就会这样。

lines.en: : It’s like...all I can think of is trying to write them down accurately, but then nothing ever makes sense and it drives me insane and I’ve always just...locked myself up until it was over.
lines.zh: : 就好像……我满脑子只想把它们准确地写下来，可到头来什么都说不通，把我逼疯，而我总是……把自己关起来，直到这一切结束。

lines.en: : Just...can’t really do that anymore now that I live in a dorm with nineteen other girls. One of which I’m dating.
lines.zh: : 只是……现在我跟另外十九个女孩一起住在宿舍里，就没法再这么干了。其中一个还是我在交往的人。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you had to see me like this. Both of you. I know it’s not pretty.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉你们看到了我这个样子。你们两个。我知道这不好看。

lines.en: : Well...you seem a little better now. But maybe it’d be for the best if you took a little break from writing to just...cool down or something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……你现在看起来好一点了。不过也许最好先停一停写作，去……冷静一下什么的？

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair31
: Cool down?! Now?! But I’m so fucking close to-
lines.zh: : 冷静？！现在？！可我就他妈的快——

lines.en: : Otoha.
lines.zh: : Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair32
: Yeah...you’re right. Sorry. I’m still kind of...caught up in the...colors...Uhh...no...No, thats not the right way to word it. Uhh...fuck. Give me a second.
lines.zh: : 是啊……你说得对。抱歉。我还有点……陷在那些……颜色里……呃……不……不，这么说不对。呃……操。给我一秒钟。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair33
: This new song you’re writing...
lines.zh: : 你在写的这首新歌……

lines.en: : It’s not about me...is it?
lines.zh: : 不是写我的吧……是吗？

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair34
: Uhh...
: I don’t...I don’t really like talking about my songs until they’re done, so...
lines.zh: : 我不……我不太喜欢在歌写完之前谈它们，所以……

lines.en: : Will you let me hear it once it’s finished?
lines.zh: : 写完之后能让我听听吗？

lines.en: : Y-Yeah. Totally. You can...hear it...when it’s done. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 当、当然。没问题。你……可以听……等写完之后。没问题的。

lines.en: : I’m looking forward to it...
lines.zh: : 我很期待……

lines.en: : Well...I should probably leave you two alone now that Rin is no longer at risk of being mutilated by her lover.
lines.zh: : 嗯……既然 Rin 不再有被她恋人弄残的风险，我大概该让你们俩单独待着了。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair35
: I wouldn’t mind having a bodyguard for the rest of the night now that it looks like Otoha doesn’t need to be alone anymore.
lines.zh: : 既然 Otoha 看起来不再需要独处了，我倒不介意今晚剩下的时候有个保镖在身边。

lines.en: : I’d still...kind of like to be alone...
lines.zh: : 我还是……有点想一个人待着……

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair36
: But it would make me {i}reeeeeeeally{/i} happy if we could all go to the cafe together. And I could definitely use the pick me up after all I’ve been through tonight.
lines.zh: : 可要是咱们能一起去咖啡厅，我会{i}非──常{/i}开心的。而且今晚经历了这么多，我确实需要提提神。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair37
: That’s mean...you know I can’t say no to you right now.
lines.zh: : 你这招太狠了……你知道我现在没法拒绝你。

lines.en: : Just for a little while? I’ve wanted to see you all weekend and I’d hate for this to be the way that ended.
lines.zh: : 就待一小会儿？我整个周末都想见你，我可不想让这个周末就这么结束。

lines.en: : Are you...okay with me looking like this, though? Because I don’t really think I can do my makeup right now. My hands are all {i}blah{/i} from writing and erasing things all day.
lines.zh: : 不过……你能接受我这副样子吗？因为我觉得我现在化不了妆。我的手因为整天写写擦擦，已经{i}废{/i}了。

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair38
: Leave it to me! Years of self-mutilation have made me into a wizard with makeup and I have been practicing to one day apply my girlfriend’s since elementary school!
lines.zh: : 交给我吧！多年的自残把我练成了化妆大师，而且我从小学起就一直在练习，就为了有一天能给我女朋友化妆！

lines.en: : Welp, once again, I’ll leave you to it and-
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我再一次把这里交给你们，然后——

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair39
: Nonsense! You’re coming too!
lines.zh: : 胡说！你也要来！

lines.en: : {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair40
: Because I don’t want this to be {i}your{/i} final memory of the weekend either. Let’s just all have some fun the way we normally do and put all of this drama behind us. Cool?
lines.zh: : 因为我也不想让这成为{i}你{/i}对这个周末的最后记忆。我们就照平时那样一起玩一玩，把这一出全抛到脑后。行吗？

lines.en: : Barring Futaba, all my favorite people are here with me right now. And nothing would make it easier to put this all behind us than overpriced, caffeinated beverages I will receive at a discounted rate.
lines.zh: : 除了 Futaba 之外，我最喜欢的人现在都跟我在一起了。而要让我们把这一切抛到脑后，最好的办法莫过于那些贵得离谱、但我能拿折扣价的含咖啡因饮料了。

lines.en: : I can’t have dairy...
lines.zh: : 我不能吃奶制品……

lines.en: scene otohasnewhair41
: Soy milk exists. Now stop trying to make up excuses and go sit on the bed so I can make you look presentable.
lines.zh: : 有豆奶啊。别再找借口了，去床上坐着，我好把你收拾得体面点。

lines.en: scene black
I wind up walking around the room as Rin “fixes” Otoha to collect the shards of broken glass from things  that she and Nodoka have decided weren’t important enough to preserve.
lines.zh: Rin 在“收拾”Otoha 的时候，我在房间里走来走去，捡起那些玻璃碎片——它们来自她和 Nodoka 认定不值得保留的东西。

lines.en: I can’t help but contort my worldview until pieces of Rin are scooped into my hands alongside the shards.
lines.zh: 我忍不住扭曲自己的世界观，直到 Rin 的碎片也和那些玻璃碴一起被我捧进手心。

lines.en: Is {i}she{/i} worth preserving in the eyes of someone who nearly shattered her just moments ago?
lines.zh: 在那个片刻前差点把她击碎的人眼里，{i}她{/i}值得被保留吗？

lines.en: Or will she eventually slip through Otoha’s fingers as part of another unfortunate “accident?”
lines.zh: 还是说，她最终会作为又一场不幸的“意外”，从 Otoha 的指缝间滑落？

lines.en: That remains to be seen.
lines.zh: 这还有待观察。

lines.en: And hopefully next time, I won’t be around for it.
lines.zh: 但愿下一次，我不会在场。
